basic_details.job_title: MAKAUT Training and Placement Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One post of Training and Placement Officer (Purely Contractual Basis) in the Centre for Placement and Training of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly known as West Bengal University of Technology), Haringhata, Nadia, is open to Indian nationals. Applications go by email to [email protected], and the last date of receipt of application is 4 December 2026. The pay is Rs. 80,000/- per month (consolidated).

qualification.details: First class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in any branch of Engineering/Technology. Preferably possessing an MBA-HR degree from a reputed University (preferred, as the notice words it). At least five years of experience in Training and Placement Activities. Applications are invited from Indian nationals. | The notice does not mention an age limit for this post. For the full eligibility wording, see the official notification. | The remuneration is Rs. 80,000/- per month, consolidated. The position is on a purely contractual basis. The notice does not mention the length of the contract or any allowances.

rows.details: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (Formerly Known as West Bengal University of Technology)
Training and Placement Officer (Purely Contractual Basis)
First class or equivalent Bachelor's or Master's in any branch of Engineering/Technology, with at least five years of experience in Training and Placement Activities
Centre for Placement and Training, MAKAUT, Haringhata, Nadia, West Bengal

content_sections.heading: About MAKAUT
content_sections.text: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal (MAKAUT, WB), formerly known as West Bengal University of Technology, is a university located at Haringhata, Simhat, District Nadia, PIN-741249. This post is in the university's Centre for Placement and Training.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is sent by email. The notice asks candidates to send the following to the email address [email protected] : A detailed bio-data. All academic and administrative credentials, along with experience certificates, etc. A covering letter addressed to "The Registrar, Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, NH-12, Haringhata, Simhat, Nadia, West Bengal - 741249". The email subject line as printed in the notice: "Application for the post of.............. (Contractual)", with the post name in the blank. The notice says the university invites applications "in the prescribed form" and also says: "For applying for the above post, please visit website: http://www.makautwb.ac.in ". No separate form is printed in the notice itself. The application must be received by 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: First class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in any branch of Engineering/Technology. Preferably possessing an MBA-HR degree from a reputed University (preferred, as the notice words it). At least five years of experience in Training and Placement Activities. Applications are invited from Indian nationals. The notice does not mention an age limit for this post. For the full eligibility wording, see the official notification. The remuneration is Rs. 80,000/- per month, consolidated. The position is on a purely contractual basis. The notice does not mention the length of the contract or any allowances.
